name: Fake Credit Card (Test Numbers)
summary: Generate Luhn-valid test card numbers for payment sandboxes — not real cards.
description: Create Visa, Mastercard, Amex, or Discover test PANs with expiry and CVV for UI and sandbox testing. Includes known Stripe-style fixtures. Numbers are generated locally and are for testing only — never use for real charges.

faqs.question: Are these real credit cards?
faqs.answer: No. They only satisfy the Luhn checksum for sandbox/UI testing. They cannot authorize real purchases.

faqs.question: Will they work with Stripe?
faqs.answer: Use “known sandbox number” for Stripe’s documented test PANs (e.g. 4242…). Random Luhn-valid numbers may still be declined by gateways that only accept their published fixtures.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
